music: Existing theme low; gentle curiosity, no comic disgust at modest food and no triumphant aristocratic fanfare.
mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Open-air market by day: low voices without words, baskets set down, a cart wheel on stone far off. No shouting, no music.
A wicker basket set down on a wooden table once. No rattle.
A knife cutting through a crusty round loaf on a board, two slow strokes.
Small domestic hearth fire crackling quietly. No roar.
A roasting spit turned slowly over a hearth, a soft creak and a drip of fat hissing once.
A pot of water at a simmer, soft bubbling, as cut cabbage is dropped in with one small splash.
Cooked cabbage squeezed by hand over a bowl, two wet presses. No slap.
An earthenware or iron lid set onto a pot once, a dull ceramic tap.
A small pan at a gentle simmer with ham and mushrooms, soft sizzle. No electric hiss.
Broth poured from an earthen jug into a pan, one short pour.
Sauce poured through a sieve into a bowl, a thin steady trickle, two seconds.
One ceramic serving dish placed on a cloth-covered wooden table. No clatter.
Soft masonry-oven wood fire with a faint draw. No roar.
A wooden peel slid into a masonry oven once, dry scrape.
Small pastries frying in fat, steady gentle sizzle, three seconds.
Two plates stacked gently and lifted, soft ceramic contact.
